title: The Clockwork
summary: Run the Clockwork's machine: Winders, the Clocktower and its gear rings, the Cog Presses for cogs and the Mainspring for Tension, then the Light Works and its Clock Soldiers.
learn: The Clocktower and the gear rings (meshing, the GEAR VIEW)
The Light Works and Clock Soldiers

say: Welcome to the Clockwork. I am Master Tock, and this is your Clocktower.
Beside it stands a Cog Press. Its Winders turn it, and it presses cogs: your money.
Train a Winder. Winders wind the machines, carry the building crates and repair.
Every Clockwork building stands on a ring of ground gears. A ring must mesh with your others, or it never turns.

say.pc: Press the ` key, under Esc, or GEAR VIEW on a building's card, to see the whole network.
say.phone: Tap GEAR VIEW on a building's card to see the whole network.

say: Green rings turn at full speed. Red ones are stopped: they mesh with nothing.
Close the view again the same way.
Each Clocktower takes two Cog Presses. Build the second.

say.pc: Select a Winder, press BUILD (B), pick the COG PRESS. While placing, G picks its ring: SMALL or BIG GEAR.
say.phone: Select a Winder, tap BUILD, pick the COG PRESS. While placing, the gear button picks its ring: SMALL or BIG.

say: Place it so its ring meshes with the others. A Winder carries its crate there.

say.pc: A press with nobody on it presses nothing. Select Winders and right-click the new press.
say.phone: A press with nobody on it presses nothing. Select Winders and tap the new press.

say: Each Winder adds the same share of cogs. Train more Winders if you run short.
steps.task: Put 2 Winders on each Cog Press.

say: Cogs are your money. TENSION is your second resource, and the Mainspring winds it.
Build a Mainspring. Each Clocktower takes one.
Put Winders on the Mainspring to crank it. Its Tension flows through every meshed ring.
Now the army. Build a Light Works: it assembles Clock Soldiers.
Select the Light Works and make two Clock Soldiers: quick swords behind a shield.
Machines run down away from a Clocktower or a Spring Tower. Winders crank them up again, and repair them.
Cogs, Tension and meshing rings: that is the Clockwork. Try it in a practice game.

you.text: You trained a Winder, read the gear network, wound the presses and the Mainspring, and made Clock Soldiers.
